Chat Edit: '- change the color of the dropdown buttons and all other buttons from that weird white to become more aesthetically pleasing
- I cant see anything on the waybar related to this
- There is no point of asking for category if you are putting the task in the focused panel ultimately
- if 'a' is pressed to open a new task, esc isnt closing it
- update the user_guideles.md and fix the typo in the name
- add a but of space between the buttons on the top right and the "0 tasks" written (just 2 px of space)
- Deleting a category isnt undoing
- Have you given the todo its own named workspace? if yes, make sure the keybindings are: super + shift + h
- if 'a' is adding a new task, the task name automatically has 'a' written on it for some reason
- `find a task` is actually just adding the task to the focused panel
'
